_comment: Schema descriptions keyed by wildcarded paths ('*' = one segment; applied at every depth incl. map items and array elements by gen_schema_lib.annotate()). POLICY — every field is one of two kinds: the RUNTIME READ SURFACE (consumers load it at boot; removal needs consumer-rev coordination) or the DEPLOYMENT LEDGER, marked by the phrase 'no runtime consumer' (the on-chain record of what a deploy created; removable as a data-only change once truly unread). Unmarked = runtime surface.
packages/*/published_at: Package id of the current latest version — the tx-call target. Changes on every upgrade.
packages/*/original_id: Package id of the FIRST publish. Never changes across upgrades; used to build type tags (<original_id>::module::Type).
packages/*/version: On-chain package version: 1 at first publish, +1 per upgrade.
packages/*/upgrade_capability: UpgradeCap object id. Deploy-time artifact; no runtime consumer.
packages/*/mvr: Move Registry (MVR) registration for this package. Mainnet only today.
symbols: The single symbol universe: the ONLY place a symbol is introduced. Every symbol-keyed map elsewhere must reference a key from here (CI-enforced).
oracle_rules/waterx/enclave: The ONE home for enclave identity (object, cap, config, pubkey).
oracle_rules/waterx/enclave/pubkey: Registered enclave ed25519 pubkey (hex, no 0x). The SOLE config home; k8s-infra pins an independent env copy by design (boot-without-enclave).
oracle_rules/pyth/pyth_price_feeds: Per-symbol Pyth price feed: feed_id (Pyth) + price_info_object (Sui object the keeper refreshes).
oracle_rules/pyth/pyth_price_feeds/*/fee: Pyth price-feed identifier (32-byte hex). NOT a Sui object id.
oracle_rules/pyth/pyth_price_feeds/*/pri: The shared PriceInfoObject itself — NOT the Field<PriceIdentifier, ID> wrapper object; passing the wrapper is the classic mistake.
oracle_rules/pyth_lazer/lazer_feed_ids: Per-symbol Pyth Lazer numeric feed id, as used by the keeper's Lazer WS subscription.
objects/oracle/aggregators: Per-symbol on-chain Aggregator object id — the cross-rule weighted-median aggregation point.
objects/perp/markets: Per-symbol perp market: market + config object ids.
objects/custody/assets: Native-custody asset rows. mint_fee_scaled / burn_fee_scaled are u128 1e9-scaled (0 = no fee; 1_000_000 = 0.1%; 1_000_000_000 = 100%). min_burn_amount is the dust floor in the asset's smallest unit.
evm/bridge/chains/*/wormhole_core: Wormhole core contract address on this EVM chain (20-byte, 0x + 40 hex).
evm/bridge/chains/*/deposit_vault: Deposit vault contract address on this EVM chain (20-byte, 0x + 40 hex).
objects/oracle/listing_cap: ListingCap object id. Deploy-time artifact (asset-listing tooling); no runtime consumer.
objects/bridge/limits: Bridge limit values recorded at deploy; runtime reads live limits from chain (getBridgeLimits RPC) — no runtime consumer.
evm: EVM-side bridge deployment ledger (chains, core/vault addresses, tokens); source of truth for trusted emitters at DEPLOY time — no runtime consumer.
oracle_rules/supra: Dormant rule: kept as deployment ledger — no runtime consumer. Activating Supra needs schema additions first (enabled/oracle_holder have no v2 home).
